questions.text: What does the social media text say algorithms are optimised for?
questions.hint: "Optimised for the content that triggers the strongest emotional response — outrage, anxiety, envy."

questions.text: What does research show about handwriting vs typing notes?
opts: Handwriting leads to better understanding and retention
questions.correct: Handwriting leads to better understanding and retention
questions.hint: "Students who handwrite their notes understand and retain more than students who type them."

questions.text: The social media text says social media is always harmful.
questions.hint: "The case for social media is not difficult to make." — it presents both sides.

questions.text: The technology text says a smartphone on a desk reduces ___ even if unused.
questions.hint: "Reduce cognitive performance simply because of its proximity."

questions.text: What is the main conclusion of both technology reading texts?
opts: Technology is a tool — it depends on how it is used
questions.correct: Technology is a tool — it depends on how it is used
questions.hint: Both texts conclude: technology is a tool; use matters more than the tool itself.

questions.text: What does the social media text say about social media literacy?
opts: It's as important as reading and writing — maybe more so
questions.correct: It's as important as reading and writing — maybe more so
questions.hint: "Social media literacy... is as important as reading and writing. Perhaps more so."

questions.text: What types of tasks does Amir say are already being replaced by automation?
opts: Routine tasks — data entry, basic customer service
questions.correct: Routine tasks — data entry, basic customer service
questions.hint: "Data entry, basic customer service, simple manufacturing." — already being replaced.

questions.text: What does Zhibek say about coaches who use AI?
opts: They will be enhanced — not replaced
questions.correct: They will be enhanced — not replaced
questions.hint: "The coach who uses AI tools well will be better — not replaced. The tool enhances the human."

questions.text: Which skills does Amir say will be most valuable?
opts: Critical thinking, creativity, AI literacy, languages
questions.correct: Critical thinking, creativity, AI literacy, languages
questions.hint: "Critical thinking. Creativity. The ability to work with AI. And languages — especially English."

questions.text: What does Zhibek say about the education system?
opts: It needs to adapt faster — still training for disappearing jobs
It's the best in Central Asia
questions.correct: It needs to adapt faster — still training for disappearing jobs
questions.hint: "The education system needs to adapt much faster... still training people for jobs that are disappearing."

questions.text: Amir describes himself as "___ optimistic" about the future of work.
questions.hint: "Cautiously optimistic. Technology has always created new jobs alongside the ones it eliminated."

questions.text: Zhibek's optimism is conditional on:
questions.hint: "I'm optimistic if education changes. If it doesn't, I'm worried."

questions.text: "She is ___ engineer." Choose.
questions.hint: "engineer" starts with vowel "e" → AN engineer. ✅

questions.text: "I bought ___ laptop. ___ laptop was expensive." Choose.
questions.hint: 1st mention → "A". 2nd mention (known) → "THE". ✅

questions.text: "___ education is important." — Choose.
questions.hint: "Education" as a general concept = zero article. "EDUCATION is important." ✅

questions.text: "She is ___ best student in the class." — Choose.
questions.hint: Superlative = always THE. "THE best student." ✅

questions.text: "She speaks ___ Kazakh." — Choose.
questions.hint: Languages = zero article. "She speaks KAZAKH." ✅

questions.text: "___ internet has changed the world." — Choose.
questions.hint: "THE internet" = unique. There is only one internet. ✅

questions.text: "She goes to ___ gym every day." (fixed expression)
questions.hint: Fixed: "go to THE gym." ✅

questions.text: "___ music at the concert was amazing." — Choose.
questions.hint: "THE music at the concert" = specific music, at this event. ✅

questions.text: "The platform maximises engagement." "Engagement" means:
questions.hint: "engagement" = active involvement; how much users interact with content.

questions.text: "The research is contested." "Contested" means:
questions.hint: "contested" = disputed; different experts have different conclusions.

questions.text: "Students retain more when handwriting." "Retain" means:
questions.hint: "retain" = to keep; to continue to have information in memory over time.

questions.text: "The benefits outweigh the risks." "Outweigh" means:
questions.hint: "outweigh" = to be greater or more important.

questions.text: "Curated images of other people's lives." "Curated" means:
opts: Carefully selected to create an impression
questions.correct: Carefully selected to create an impression
questions.hint: "curated" = carefully selected and arranged, usually to create a specific impression.
